ph.quote: Squacquerone has a pH of about 5.1, humidity of 60%, fat and protein content are about 18.5 and 15% respectively, and NaCl content is less than 1%.

ammonia.reason: Days-old pasteurized curd at 4C with no surface flora and minimal deamination.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk with no washed-rind flora to make p-cresol/indole.

bitter.reason: Very short storage limits rennet/plasmin hydrophobic peptide accumulation.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no blue-ketone 2-heptanone/2-nonanone pathway.

browning.reason: Very high moisture and brief heating limits Maillard despite residual lactose.

buttery.reason: S. thermophilus pyruvate/citrate metabolism yields diacetyl and acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipolysis in 1-15 day cheese limits free butanoic/hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: 60-69% moisture plus ~46-59% FDM fat lubricates demineralized casein matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Hydrated low-pH rennet gel flows rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: High moisture and pH ~5.1 calcium solubilization gives soft spreadable body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylalanine catabolism to phenylethanol reported only as relative %.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterase esterification in cold storage.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine C6-C10 and 4-methyloctanoic acid signature.

malty_nutty.reason: No aging for Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine.

melt.reason: pH 5.1-5.35 demineralized casein fuses readily when warmed on piadina.

oil_off.reason: Only ~18.5% fat well emulsified in fresh high-moisture matrix.

smoky.reason: No smoke application and no guaiacol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: S. thermophilus lactose to L-lactic acid to pH ~5.1 with little acetic acid.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, no aligned paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurization only with no curd cooking, low methional/DMS from whey protein.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/lactate and <1% salt enhance milky sweet perception.

umami.reason: No aging proteolysis so very low free glutamate/aspartate.
